NORYN adds standard includes in fm_core.h and builds the integer kernels with defined signed wraparound on GCC/Clang. All original copyright/license headers are retained. NORYN provides its own operator envelopes, original voice configurations and UI; it does not bundle imported DX7 factory or artist patch banks.
